_comment: Shared blocks for data/api/ event files. Nothing here applies unless a file or row names the block in "use". sharedSources: the events whose recordings give the shared response parts (expected/_shared/), before any other event's

trade-response-parts._comment: Every trade API returns the trade's basic and instrument parts: TestDataTool compact keeps each once per product in expected/_shared/ and writes references to them (the keys that differ stay in the case's file). Name it in "use" of an event whose response holds data.trade

trade-part-rules._comment: The dynamic values of the shared parts, written against the part ({basic}.dealDate): each case's sharedFragments says where the part is in its event's response (data.trade.basic, data.basic). Name it in "use" of every event that declares the parts, so they are masked alike
